Line 1 Yonge-University: There will be no subway service between College and Osgoode stations, starting 11:59 p.m., on Friday, November 27, due to planned track work. Shuttle buses will operate.
Line 1 Yonge-University: There is no subway service between Bloor-Yonge and Osgoode stations due to planned track work. Shuttle buses are running.

Line 1 Yonge-University: There will be no subway service between Bloor-Yonge and Osgoode stations, starting 11:59 p.m., nightly Monday, November 23 to Thursday, November 26, due to planned track work. Shuttle buses will operate.

https://www.ttc.ca/service-advisories/Service-Changes/88-Route-change-due-to-Ontario-Line-construction
88 South Leaside – Route change, due to Ontario Line construction

The routing of the 88 South Leaside will be adjusted to accommodate the temporary full closure of Beth Nealson Drive for Ontario Line construction. 
 
88A South Leaside will be adjusted to operate between St Clair Station and Thorncliffe Park. 
 
88B South Leaside will be adjusted to operate between St Clair Station and Wicksteed Avenue via Laird Station. 
 
To accommodate local travel, temporary service on the new 156 Millwood will begin, operating between Thorncliffe Park and Wicksteed Avenue via Laird Station. 
 
Service on the 156 Millwood will operate every 25 to 30 minutes approximately between 5 a.m. and 7 p.m. on weekdays, 5:30 a.m. and 7 p.m. on Saturdays, and 7 a.m. and 7 p.m. on Sundays.

https://www.ttc.ca/service-advisories/Service-Changes/11B-11C-52F-124-Route-change-due-to-service-improvements
– Route change, due to service improvements

Routing on 11 Bayview will be adjusted in all time periods to provide expanded service between Lawrence Station and Sunnybrook Hospital. With this change, service on 11C Bayview (Davisville Station-Sunnybrook) will be removed and replaced with extended service on 11B Bayview (Davisville Station-Lawrence Station via Sunnybrook), which will operate north of Sunnybrook Hospital to Lawrence Station via Raab Boulevard, Wellness Way, Bayview Avenue and Lawrence Avenue East. 
 
Service on 52F Lawrence West (Lawrence Station-Royal York) will be extended in all time periods on weekdays and Saturdays to operate east of Lawrence Station to Sunnybrook Hospital via Lawrence Avenue East, Bayview Avenue, Wellness Way, and Raab Boulevard. 
 
With this change, service will be removed from 124 Sunnybrook in all time periods as part of the 2026 Annual Network Plan. Customers can use adjusted service on 11B Bayview and 52F Lawrence West as outlined above.
https://www.ttc.ca/service-advisories/Service-Changes/43-Route-change-due-to-service-adjustments
43 Kennedy – Route change, due to service adjustments

Service will be removed from the 43C Kennedy (Kennedy Station-Village Green Square) branch in the early morning, morning peak and afternoon peak periods on weekdays. Customers can access alternative service via stops on Kennedy Road at Village Green Square. 
 
Service on 43B Kennedy (Kennedy Station-Scarborough Centre via Progress) will also be restored in the early evening period on weekdays to improve service accessibility during this time period.

https://www.ttc.ca/service-advisories/Service-Changes/939-Route-change-due-to-service-adjustments
939 Finch Express – Route change due to service adjustments

Routing on the 939A Finch Express (Finch StationKennedy Station) and 939B Finch Express (Finch West Station-Kennedy Station) branches will be adjusted in all time periods to no longer operate between Scarborough Centre Station and Kennedy Station to better align service with ridership demand on the Scarborough Busway. 
 
With this change, service on the 939C Finch Express (Finch Station-Morningside Heights) branch will also be added in the midday and early evening period on weekdays, and in the morning and afternoon periods on weekends to improve express bus accessibility throughout Scarborough. Buses will operate every 15 to 20 minutes during these time periods. 
 
Further, service on the 939A Finch Express (Finch Station-Kennedy Station) will be removed in the midday and early evening period on weekdays, and in the morning and afternoon periods on weekends as a result of this change.
https://www.ttc.ca/service-advisories/Service-Changes/904-Route-change-due-to-service-adjustments
904 Sheppard-Kennedy Express – Route change due to service adjustments

Routing on 904 Sheppard-Kennedy Express will be adjusted in all time periods to no longer operate between Scarborough Centre Station and Kennedy Station to better align service with ridership demand on the Scarborough Busway. Service will continue to operate between Scarborough Centre Station and Don Mills Station. 
 
With this change, service on 904 Sheppard-Kennedy Express will also be rebranded to 904 Don Mills-Scarborough Express to reflect the adjusted routing as outlined above.

https://www.ttc.ca/service-advisories/Service-Changes/31-501-301-503-Route-change-due-to-track-work
– Route change, due to track work

Service on 31 Greenwood buses will continue to divert via Dundas Street East, Jones Avenue, Queen Street East and Leslie Street during the TTC track construction on Queen Street East, Leslie Street to Vancouver Avenue.
 
Streetcar service on the 501/301 Queen is diverting via Gerrard Street East between Broadview Avenue and Coxwell Avenue. 501B Queen and 503 Kingston Rd replacement buses are diverting both ways to Eastern Avenue between Emdaabiimok/Coxwell Avenue and Leslie Street.
 
There will be no service on Queen Street East between Coxwell/Emdaabiimok Avenue and Leslie Street.
 
To learn more about this construction project, please visit: Queen Street East.

https://www.ttc.ca/service-advisories/Service-Changes/506B-306B-replacement-buses-will-be-adjusted-to-regular-routing
– Replacement buses will be adjusted to regular routing

Westbound service on the 506B/306B Carlton replacement buses will be adjusted to regular routing via College Street between Yonge Street and Bay Street as the construction progresses.
 
506B/306B Carlton replacement buses will now operate between Spadina Station and Gerrard Street East and Broadview Avenue via Spadina Avenue, College Street, Carlton Street, Parliament Street and Gerrard Street East in both directions. 
 
 506/306 Carlton Streetcars will continue to divert via Dundas Street between Bay Street and Parliament Street.
https://www.ttc.ca/service-advisories/Service-Changes/501-301-507-508-Route-change-due-to-construction-ending
– Route change due to construction ending

Streetcar service on 507 Long Branch will be reinstated as construction at Long Branch Loop ends. With this change, 507M and 507 Long Branch bus replacement services will be removed. 
 
Further, service during the late evening period on weekdays and weekends will be removed and replaced by 501C Queen streetcar service. 
 
Streetcar service on 508 Lake Shore will be removed on weekdays as the City's watermain construction on King Street West, between Close Avenue and Dufferin Street begins. Customers can continue to use alternative service on 501 Queen, 504 King and/or 507 Long Branch.
https://www.ttc.ca/service-advisories/Service-Changes/503-504-304-508-Route-changes
– Route change, due to construction

504/304 King streetcar service will be adjusted in all time periods as the City's watermain construction on King Street West, between Close Avenue and Dufferin Street, begins. With this change, 504/304 King streetcars will divert via Queen Street West between Roncesvalles Avenue and Shaw Street. 
 
As of November 1, 504/304 King streetcar service has been operating as a single branch between Dundas West Station and Broadview Station.
 
504C/304C King replacement bus service is operating between Sunnyside Loop (Roncesvalles Avenue) and Distillery Loop (Front Street East and Cherry Street) in all time periods.
 
503 Kingston Rd replacement bus service has also been extended to Dufferin Gate Loop in all time periods for the duration of this construction.
https://www.ttc.ca/service-advisories/Service-Changes/509-510-310-Temporary-route-change-due-to-streetcar-infrastructure-work
– Temporary route change due to streetcar infrastructure work

509 Harbourfront streetcars will operate between Exhibition Loop and Queens Quay Loop (Queens Quay West and Spadina Avenue). Customers travelling between Queens Quay Loop and Union Station can take the 509B Harbourfront and 310 Spadina replacement buses. 
 
509B Harbourfront and 310 Spadina replacement buses will operate between Union Station and Bathurst Street and Lakeshore Boulevard West. At Union Station, board replacement buses on the west side of Bay Street, south of Front Street West. 
 
On Queens Quay West, westbound buses will serve curb side stops, eastbound buses will serve streetcar platform stops.
 
Customers can transfer between streetcars and replacement buses at Queens Quay West and Spadina Avenue. 
 
510A/310 Spadina streetcars will operate between Spadina Station and Queens Quay Loop. 
 
510B Spadina streetcars will operate between Spadina Station and King Street West (Charlotte Loop). 
 
Transfer points: 
Westbound and northbound streetcars: board inside Queens Quay Loop, east of Spadina Avenue.
Eastbound buses: board on the south side of Queens Quay West, east of Spadina Avenue. 
Westbound buses: from Union Station, board on the west side of Bay Street, south of Front Street West.
 
To accommodate additional track work on Queens Quay West, temporary stop relocations and stop removal will be in effect for eastbound 509B Harbourfront and 310 Spadina replacement bus service from November 26 to December 2, 2026. Customers boarding at Queens Quay West at Lower Spadina Avenue and Queens Quay West at Rees Street will be redirected to nearby on-street stops. The stop located at Harbourfront Centre will be temporarily removed.
